title: GoatCitadel benchmark targets
description: Pluggable target configuration for benchmark/run.mjs. Copy targets.example.json to targets.json (gitignored) and fill in the seams. Absent targets are skipped, not failed.

goatcitadel.description: The local GoatCitadel gateway. In-process scenarios need neither baseUrl nor keys.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of a running gateway, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. Null = HTTP scenarios skip unless --spin is passed.

mode.description: none/loopback need no header; token sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.

competitor.description: A competitor target. Provide a command (binary to spawn) OR a baseUrl (running instance). Absent both = skipped.

command.description: Path/command to the competitor binary the runner can spawn.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of an already-running competitor instance.
